architecture.mechanism: Formation of protective calcareous deposits on steel surfaces due to high-potential cathodic polarization
architecture.intervention: Implement a localized rectifier boost (increasing CP potential to -0.95 V vs. CSE) at the far ends of the pipeline, prioritizing these areas over the center to compensate for the higher resistance of the 36-inch pipe and coating holidays.
architecture.expected_effect: Inhibits bacterial adhesion and promotes the deposition of calcium carbonate scale at coating defect sites, effectively sealing holidays and reducing current drain, allowing the standard -0.85 V target to be maintained at the far ends within the existing power budget.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure water chemistry (pH and hardness) at the far ends and inspect exposed test coupons or use close-interval potential surveys; if calcareous deposits do not form or if the potential remains at -0.72 V after increasing the local potential to -0.95 V, the mechanism fails.
